prompt: Edit the provided already-public approved RTS Human Worker sprite into a usable transparent sprite pose sheet. Preserve this exact character: adult brown-haired bearded male, cream rolled sleeves and apron tail, muted dark teal vest, brown leather boots/cuffs/belt, brown backpack with tightly rolled golden bedroll. Preserve painted semi-realistic outlined RTS style, ordinary anatomy, same fixed isometric camera as this seed. EVERY pose is the SAME actual EAST heading seen in this seed: front three-quarter, looking screen-down-right, face/chest visible, backpack on upper-left/back. Never rotate to the right-side profile or front view. Do not draw multiple directions. Output exactly SIX complete separate whole-character keys in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, landscape 1536x1024, transparent background, no labels, no shadows, no floor. Keep each whole silhouette, hands, feet and tool at least 25 px from its cell edges with large transparent gaps. Columns use stable ground root centers at x=256,768,1280. Each standing/crouching character body should be about 300 px tall (head-to-ground at rest), same anatomical scale throughout; row1 ground contact around y=470, row2 contact around y=960. Row1 is STONE MINING with a compact recognizable steel PICKAXE, definitely a pointed pick rather than axe or hammer. Three phases left-to-right: compact pick windup behind upper shoulder, pick strike angled screen-down-right toward nearby low stone, recoil/recovery ready stance. Do not draw stone, ground or impact particles. No oversized overhead reach. Row2 is DEFEAT/DEATH one-shot in the SAME EAST bearing: left key knees buckling and torso dropping while hands release the tool; middle key collapsing toward screen-down-right with torso tipped and one forearm bracing; right key completely motionless PRONE terminal corpse lying head screen-down-right and feet screen-up-left, clearly no standing or sitting, backpack and bedroll still attached, no detached floating weapon, no blood. Falling poses retain exact character proportions and fixed camera; terminal whole horizontal body fully fits its own 512x512 cell. Keep consistent root/ground location within each column, no dramatic flying displacement. All six silhouettes must be distinct readable phases, complete and uncropped. Keep character palette and recognizable silhouette faithful to the seed; no blue apron, yellow cap, grey hair, new costume, new perspective or new character. Motion may be simple; usable readable complete poses and exact heading matter more than polish.
